sentences.text: Code vs In Re : Kashinath Shil & Anr on 19 January, 2023

Author: Debangsu Basak
Bench: Debangsu Basak
19.01.2023 Kaushik Allowed C.R.M.(A) 270 of 2023 In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail
under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Kushmandi Police Station
Case No. 211 of 2022 dated 21.09.2022 under Sections 498A/302/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

And In Re : Kashinath Shil & Anr.
...... petitioners Mr. Ali Ahsan Alamgir Mr. M. A. Chowdhury ....for the petitioners Mr. S.
G.Mukherjee, learned Public Prosecutor Mr. Aniket Mitra ....for the State The police filed charge-sheet.
Apparently, the statement of the son of the victim implicates the husband of the victim.
The sister-in-law of the victim was enlarged on anticipatory bail by the Sessions Court.
In such circumstances, we grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners, who are the parents-in-law of the victim.

Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest the petitioners shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- each, with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also be subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and on condition that the petitioners shall appear on every date before the jurisdictional Court on and from the date fixed for appearance of the accused and in default the jurisdictional Court will pass appropriate order to secure the presence of the petitioners in Court including cancelling the anticipatory bail granted without further reference to this Court.
This application for anticipatory bail is, thus, allowed.
(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
